title: The tune panel on X: the knobs for what is on screen (the enemies by tier, the sector, the hull, the seat), live, kept in the browser, and RECORD appends a block to feedback/tune-<rev>.md on the dev server for the edit > feedback flow
context: Owner, 2026-10-16, on the VARS modal: 'it is extremely hard to use, displays in the center, cannot be easily recalled when dismissed with x, and does not obviously reference the enemy which is currently on screen, the one whose speed we want to tweak. Before we do any other feedback, overhaul the method by which we tweak each round/sector. a) a keyboard shortcut we do not use yet, say x, bring up a modal with variables FOR WHAT IS CURRENTLY on screen which can be easily tweaked, and it also must have a method to RECORD new variable so they become the new default.' Asked where the defaults should live, he chose a temporary feedback file per version that we reference in the usual edit > human feedback flow, not a write into content.
outcome: X toggles a drawer on the right edge (src/fx/tune-panel.js; Esc closes it; a seat's pointer lock is released; the seats pass X through). Its knobs (src/fx/tune-knobs.js) are built for the moment and rebuilt each second: ENEMIES ON SCREEN (every walk, and for each tier on screen by count its walk, its size and its hit points for the ones made next), the running sector (pulse size, breath), THE HULL (hits a hull, the drive's top and seconds; the lure's hops in the arena), THE GUNSHIP (seconds on station) or THE SEAT (the servo, the tolerance). A 'mul' knob multiplies the content's default, an 'abs' one replaces it; each row shows the default and the effective value, a double click puts the default back. applyTune writes the effects where the game reads them each frame: params.tune.tier[key] (src/fx/enemy-step.js: the walk, a spawn's size and hp; the record carries its tierKey), the sector loop's pulse and breath (src/fx/sector-run.js), tune.hull (playerHit's hits, the drive ramp in src/fx/hull-drive.js), tune.lure, tune.orbit (src/fx/gunship-rig.js), SENTRY_TUNE in place. Values are kept in localStorage (src/platform/tune-store.js, stalheart.tune) and applied at boot; RESET ALL clears them. RECORD builds the block (src/domain/tune.js tuneReport: the build's rev from the page's meta, the page, the sector, what was on screen, one line a changed knob: its content path, the default -> the effective value) and POSTs it to the dev server's __feedback (scripts/serve.mjs: appended to feedback/tune-<rev>.md beside the served tree; refused on --read-only), else downloads it. feedback/ is git-ignored. Harness: state().tune.
alternatives: Write the values into src/content/tune.json through the server so they are the defaults at once: the owner wants the numbers to pass through our review first.
Unfreeze the content constants and edit them live: the hot loops now read a small runtime object instead, the content stays frozen and the tests that assert it hold.
Another page in VARS: the modal is centred, modal and blind to the screen; the drawer sits beside the game and names what is in front of the player.
evidence: test/tune.mjs, test/tune-store.mjs, test/host-contracts.mjs (57 factories), test/hull-drive.mjs (the wanderer's hash unchanged), test/sector-run.mjs, test/gunship-rig.mjs
a headless run on a side server: X opened the panel on sector 2 (Cutis-Soft Ivory x88, Lemon x28, Amethyst x3 listed), a knob moved, RECORD wrote feedback/tune-main-d0a4d62a-dirty.md with the block
